title: Japanese Chicken Satay
description: A unique twist on traditional satay, this Japanese-inspired dish combines spicy chicken with malaysian flavors.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, honey, sesame oil, grated ginger, and hot sauce.
2. Add the chicken to the marinade and mix well to coat.
3. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
4. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat. Thread the marinated chicken onto the satay skewers.
5. Grill the chicken for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
6. Brush the satay with peanut sauce during the last 2 minutes of grilling.
7. Serve the chicken hot with additional peanut sauce for dipping.
8. Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
